name: Handwriting-simulator
tagline: Turn plain text into convincing handwriting images
description: Handwriting-simulator converts plain text into realistic handwritten images: handwritten fonts, paper backgrounds, and random perturbation to avoid the tell-tale uniformity of a font. A solid numpy/scipy rendering engine powers both a PyQt6 GUI and a CLI. It is a functional creative tool — the kind of thing that is genuinely fun and occasionally genuinely useful.
highlights: Realistic handwriting rendering with paper backgrounds
Random perturbation so output avoids font uniformity
Both PyQt6 GUI and CLI included
curatorNote: Handwriting simulation is usually a half-baked script; this one ships a proper rendering engine with perturbation, a GUI, and a CLI. The attention to realism is what makes it stand out.
